verdict.rationale: Prebuilt or hosted auth UI is a fair question for an auth framework, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only programmatic client and server methods (authClient.signUp.email, auth.api) and backend plugins. These are developer building blocks for building sign-in, sign-up and profile screens, not prebuilt customizable UI components or hosted pages. No evidence documents any such UI.

support.subject: As a developer, I can ship production sign-in, sign-up, and profile management with prebuilt, customizable UI components or hosted pages
